scene: leaning on a stone window ledge on a wet side street at night, taking a paper cup handed over from the right, one hand in the jeans pocket

title.en: A warm cup under the awning
title.de: Ein warmer Becher unter dem Vordach

intro.ko: 올리브 롱 코트에 브릭 레드 목도리를 감고 처마 아래에서 따뜻한 컵을 받는다.
intro.en: A brick-red scarf picks up warmth against the olive coat as he reaches for a hot cup.
intro.de: Ein ziegelroter Schal setzt einen warmen Akzent zum olivgrünen Mantel, während er nach dem heißen Becher greift.

deck.ko: 가는 비 내리는 골목에서 창턱에 기대어 뜨거운 컵을 건네받는, 올리브와 붉은 목도리의 저녁 차림.
deck.en: Olive with a red scarf on a drizzly side street, leaning on the window ledge as a hot drink is handed over.
deck.de: Olivgrün mit rotem Schal in einer verregneten Seitenstraße – an den Fenstersims gelehnt, während ein heißes Getränk herübergereicht wird.

copy.articleTitle: A WARM CUP UNDER THE AWNING
copy.pull: ONE HAND FOR THE CUP, ONE FOR THE POCKET.

tip.ko: 밖에서 따뜻한 음료를 받을 땐 한 손은 주머니에 넣어 두고, 컵을 든 손을 번갈아 녹여요.
tip.en: With a hot drink outdoors, keep one hand in a pocket and swap hands to warm them in turn.
tip.de: Mit einem heißen Getränk draußen eine Hand in der Tasche lassen und die Hände abwechselnd wärmen.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery); English product names only sentence-cased (sourceNameEn)

howToWear.ko: 올리브 코트 윗부분을 열어 붉은 목도리를 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Open the top of the olive coat to show the red scarf.
howToWear.de: Den olivgrünen Mantel oben öffnen, damit der rote Schal sichtbar bleibt.

howToWear.ko: 차콜 니트를 어두운 데님과 이어 입는다.
howToWear.en: Pair the charcoal knit with dark denim.
howToWear.de: Anthrazitfarbenen Strick mit dunklem Denim kombinieren.

howToWear.ko: 데님 밑단을 한 번 접어 부츠 윗부분을 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Turn up the denim hems once to show the tops of the boots.
howToWear.de: Den Jeanssaum einmal umschlagen, damit die Stiefelschäfte sichtbar sind.

howToWear.ko: 올리브 코트 아래 검정 가죽 부츠로 차분하게 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Keep the palette muted with black leather boots under the olive coat.
howToWear.de: Schwarze Lederstiefel zum olivgrünen Mantel tragen.

howToWear.ko: 검정 비니를 낮은 정수리 핏으로 맞춰 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Wear the black beanie close to the crown.
howToWear.de: Die schwarze Mütze eng am Kopf tragen.

howToWear.ko: 목도리를 두르고 붉은 끝을 차콜 니트 앞으로 내린다.
howToWear.en: Wrap the scarf and let the red ends fall against the charcoal knit.
howToWear.de: Den Schal wickeln und die roten Enden vor dem anthrazitfarbenen Strick hängen lassen.
